name: Herae
oneLiner: Herae is a free Chrome extension that lets two people watch movies and videos together from different places, in sync, with a video call beside the film.
short: Watch movies together long distance: one person presses play and the film starts on both screens at the same moment, on Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+, YouTube and almost any other site, with voice and video calling built in.
long: Herae keeps two browsers on the same frame of the same video. Each person plays from their own account and their own full-quality stream; only play, pause and seek events travel between them, so nothing is screen-shared and protected services such as Netflix do not show a black screen. Herae works from the page's video player itself rather than a fixed list of supported services, so it covers the major streaming services, smaller sites and embedded players. Voice and video calls are peer-to-peer, there is a live chat over the page, and Herae can keep the moments both people reacted to (detected on-device, nothing sent for analysis) as a shared timeline of the night. Partners can join from an invite link without making an account.
features: Synchronized playback (play, pause, seek) on almost any website with an HTML5 video player, including embedded players
Each person streams from their own account at full quality; nothing is screen-shared
Peer-to-peer voice and video calls in a floating window beside the film
AI Moments: reactions detected on-device and offered at the end of the night to keep
A shared timeline of nights, moments and reviews
Invite link: a partner can join without creating an account
Plan the next movie night with calendar invites and a reminder
audience: Long-distance couples first; also friends and family who watch together from different places
platforms: Google Chrome on desktop and laptop computers (Windows, macOS, Linux, ChromeOS)
limitations: Desktop Chrome only: Herae does not run on phones, tablets or smart TVs
Each person needs their own access to the streaming service; Herae does not provide, host or stream any video
Herae cannot make a title available in a country where the streaming service does not offer it

pricing.free: Free: the first two movie nights are unlimited, then 4 hours of synced watching a month; voice, video and chat included

plus.name: Herae Plus
plus.what: Unlimited synced watching and calls for one account

together.what: Unlimited, for you and one person you choose

privacy: Calls are peer-to-peer; face detection for AI Moments runs inside the browser and no video or image is sent anywhere for analysis; Herae reads the play/pause state and position of the video on the page being synced, plus its title and address, and not form fields, passwords or browsing history.
